title: Radial node comparison
statement:
Which has more radial nodes, 4s or 4d?

[_]{a}

explanations: 4d has one radial and two angular nodes.
They have the same total nodes, divided differently.
Only ℓ=n−1 gives zero radial nodes.

hints: Increasing ℓ leaves fewer of the three total nodes radial.
solution: Both have n=4. Radial nodes equal n−ℓ−1. Increasing ℓ leaves fewer of the three total nodes radial. 4d has one radial and two angular nodes.
